processed-line: - [ ] https://redhat.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/jobs/job/Remote-Austria/Technical-Account-Manager---Openshift--m-f-d-_R-058220-1 | Red Hat | Technical Account Manager - Openshift (m/f/d) | Remote Austria | posted: 2026-08-19
recommended-action: Do not apply. Role is Remote Austria and explicitly requires 'Outstanding written and verbal communication skills in German and English' — a hard language blocker (candidate is US-based in Raleigh, NC, no German). Independent of language, the role is a senior (5+ years) enterprise Technical Account Manager position requiring OpenShift/container orchestration/Kubernetes platform expertise and enterprise architecture comprehension, which does not match the candidate's mid-level frontend/solutions developer profile. Geo, language, seniority, and tech-stack mismatches are all hard blockers with no adjacent path to bridge them.
